entries.title: Psalms 64:1
segments:
. A prayer for deliverance from cunning and malicious enemies, with a confident view of their overthrow, which will honor God and give joy to the righteous. 
 
    1. preserve ... fear--as well as the danger producing it.

entries.title: Psalms 64:2
segments: 2. insurrection--literally, "uproar," noisy assaults, as well as their secret counsels.

entries.title: Psalms 64:4

entries.title: Psalms 64:5
segments: 5. A sentiment here more fully presented, by depicting their deliberate malice.

entries.title: Psalms 64:6
segments: 6. This is further evinced by their diligent efforts and deeply laid schemes.

entries.title: Psalms 64:7
segments: 7. The contrast is heightened by representing God as using weapons like theirs.

entries.title: Psalms 64:8
